name: zombie_rider.live_native_multi_recovery_controls_mcw
description: Native multi-rider impact control with identified empty-bow and stocked-bow riders, a standing susceptible player, clear legal recovery lanes and no injected attack/effect state.

steps.label: native_multi_recovery_fixture_settle
steps.expected_visible_fact: two identified hostile riders and a standing full-health player load to the native World

steps.label: audit_saved_multi_recovery_time
steps.abort_reason: installed save did not prove expected noon footing

steps.label: audit_saved_multi_recovery_escape_lanes
steps.abort_reason: the native fixture lacks the terrain required for a real recovery/separation action

steps.label: audit_saved_identified_empty_and_stocked_rider_footing
steps.abort_reason: saved active_monsters did not prove the identified empty-bow and stocked-bow hostile riders

steps.label: operate_native_multi_rider_recovery_controls
steps.objective: Use only advertised World actions. Establish each rider's native position/identity and arrow premise, then allow actual contact/closing. When a named impact downs the initially standing susceptible player, use the first advertised legal action opportunity to recover or separate along the audited open terrain. Preserve contact/path/HP/effect/timestamp evidence for the empty-bow rider and stocked-bow rider, and check the named impact's same-invocation messages for no ordinary bite or second strike. A setup label, injected effect, stationary adjacency or mere elapsed time earns no gameplay credit.
proof_targets: identified exact empty/stocked bow setup audit
downed player native advertised action and accepted recovery/separation
bounded multi-rider recovery with subsequent legal actions
no same-invocation ordinary bite or second strike
invariants: no debug attack or player-effect injection
no stationary adjacency credited as closing
no bite-only contact credited as impact
an empty-bow actor must remain empty in native observation
the post-downing player action must be advertised and accepted
no same-turn extra strike after a named impact

evidence_contract.claim: identified empty-bow and stocked-bow riders independently pressure a player through native contact impact without multi-rider lock; after native downing, an advertised player action is accepted on real terrain
evidence_contract.writeback_note: fixture setup earns no behavior credit; native contact, message, HP/effect and player-action receipts are required
